select
	ps_partkey,
	sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) as "value"
from
	partsupp,
	supplier,
	nation
where
	ps_suppkey = s_suppkey
	and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
	and n_name = 'INDIA'
group by
	ps_partkey having
		sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) > (
			select
				sum(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) * 0.0000100000
			from
				partsupp,
				supplier,
				nation
			where
				ps_suppkey = s_suppkey
				and s_nationkey = n_nationkey
				and n_name = 'INDIA'
		)
order by
	"value" desc
limit 1;

SELECT best.ps_partkey, best."value"
FROM (
    SELECT ps.ps_partkey,
           SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS "value",
           SUM(SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty)) OVER () AS total_value
    FROM partsupp AS ps
    JOIN supplier AS s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'INDIA'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
    ORDER BY "value" DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS best
WHERE best."value" > best.total_value * 0.0000100000
ORDER BY best."value" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.ps_partkey, g."value"
FROM (
    SELECT ps.ps_partkey,
           SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS "value",
           SUM(SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty)) OVER () AS total_value
    FROM partsupp AS ps
    JOIN supplier AS s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'INDIA'
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
) AS g
WHERE g."value" > g.total_value * 0.0000100000
ORDER BY g."value" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH eligible_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 7
),
eligible_items AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT i_item_sk FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Electronics', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
),
eligible_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating, cd.cd_dep_count, cd.cd_dep_employed_count, cd.cd_dep_college_count
  FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_county IN ('Northampton County','Pendleton County','Perry County','Randolph County','Woods County')
  AND c.c_birth_month IN (7, 11)
  AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'M')
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'Unknown')
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
),
qualifying_customers AS (
(SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN eligible_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN eligible_items i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN eligible_customers ec ON ec.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 77 * 0.01 AND 87 * 0.01)
INTERSECT
((SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
FROM web_sales ws
JOIN eligible_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
JOIN eligible_items i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
JOIN eligible_customers ec ON ec.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
WHERE ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 77 * 0.01 AND 87 * 0.01)
UNION
(SELECT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN eligible_dates d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN eligible_items i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN eligible_customers ec ON ec.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 77 * 0.01 AND 87 * 0.01))
)
SELECT cd_gender,
       cd_marital_status,
       cd_education_status,
       count(*) AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate,
       count(*) AS cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating,
       count(*) AS cnt3,
       cd_dep_count,
       count(*) AS cnt4,
       cd_dep_employed_count,
       count(*) AS cnt5,
       cd_dep_college_count,
       count(*) AS cnt6
FROM eligible_customers e
JOIN qualifying_customers q ON q.customer_sk = e.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating, cd_dep_count, cd_dep_employed_count, cd_dep_college_count

    SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_suppkey,
